text: Renata Ibarra and Senior SOC Analyst Priya Desai build a real Microsoft Sentinel analytics rule: Impossible Travel - Interactive Sign-ins, in the law-oakmere-soc workspace.
The rule compares a user's sign-ins, calculates the distance and time between them, and flags any pair too far apart to be real travel.
Run against live traffic, it floods the queue -- Oakmere's own backup and sync jobs authenticate from multiple regions within minutes, as designed.
The fix: a ServiceAccountTags watchlist excludes every account tagged ServiceAccount from the rule entirely, cutting the noise cleanly.
Next: rolling out Conditional Access to require MFA across the entire oakmere-cu tenant.
